_readme: Equipment catalog data for the Pokerole DM Toolkit. One record per item. SIMPLE effects are DATA (applied generically by the effect engine at each use-site, extending the legacy GEAR_EFF pattern). COMPLEX effects are NAMED HANDLERS (proc/passive) dispatched to code, wired one at a time. Full specs + rationale live in EQUIPMENT_CATALOG.md. Cosmetic-slot items carry no mechanics (pure RP, cosmetic:true) and live as labels only. Weapon-slot items carry a `weapon` stat block (anti-personnel: chip vs mon / real vs person) — combat-wiring reads BM_WEAPONS/WEAP today; unifying to this file is a later step. STATUS: FULL catalog encoded (all 14 slots) — simple effects live now via the engine; proc/passive handlers wired in Phase 2.

_schema.name: display name
_schema.cosmetic: true = pure RP label, no mechanics
_schema.mon: effect object for the mon lane
_schema.trainer: effect object for the trainer lane

_effectKeys.title: 'X' -> 'X Joe'
_effectKeys.data: extra payload for a proc/passive (e.g. type-shift {resist,weak})
